name: fdm_unlayered_5axis_printer
machine_end_gcode:
{if !virtual_5axis}M564 S0
G1 X133 Y-97 Z140 B-120 C0 F5000
G1 X133 Y-97 Z100 B-120 C0 F5000
{endif}
machine_start_gcode:
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; start bed heating early -- the M116 below waits before probing
;Set plate offset
{if curr_bed_type == "High Temp Plate"}
set global.bedType = 0
{endif}
{if curr_bed_type == "Textured PEI Plate"}
set global.bedType = 1
{endif}
{if curr_bed_type == "Cool Plate"}
set global.bedType = 2
{endif}
{if curr_bed_type == "Cool Plate"}
set global.bedType = 2
{endif}
M98 P"setBed.g"  ;set bed offset
M568 P0 R170 ;Standby/preheat temp: no-ooze preheat while homing and probing
M106 P0 S0     ;Turn off cooling fan
M106 P2 S0     ;Turn off bed fan
M568 P0 A1     ;Activate tool 1
G28                  ;Home 
M116 P0 S5
M98 P"wipe.g"
M98 p"calibrate.g"
M83                 ;Set extruder to relative mode
G90                  ;Absolute positioning
M116 S5         ;Wait for temp to 5 degrees
G32                 ;Probe bed
M568 P0 A2   ;Set tool to active temp
M98 P"Purge.g" ;Run the purge and wipe sequence
G1 X93 Y0 Z1.4
G3 X91.5 Y9.63 F500 R93 E9
G1 E-0.6 F1000
G1 Z10 F8000

{if virtual_5axis}G1 X0 Y0 Z10 F48000 ;Go to center of bed (virtual 5-axis: no rotary axes)
{else}G1 X0 Y0 Z10 B-90 C0 F48000 ;Go to center of bed
{endif}G1 E0.58 F1000
{if virtual_5axis}M201 X20000 Y20000
{else}M201 X20000 Y20000 B20000 C20000
{endif}{if virtual_5axis}M203 X48000 Y48000
{else}M203 X48000 Y48000 B48000 C48000
{endif}{if virtual_5axis}M205 X600 Y600
{else}M205 X600 Y600 B600 C600
{endif}
